{{Quote|Kneeling in victory over a fallen foe. Stylish and would probably match your sofa. Enjoy!|[[Matilda Carson]]|<ref name="SWG:MC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Matilda Carson|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''''Imperial Agent''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] environment with a recently [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] in a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Clothing/Legends|dress]], and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Mak'o Rad|soldier]] with a visor who acted as the eponymous [[Agent/Legends|agent]].<ref name="SWG:IA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The painting ''Imperial Agent'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> ''Imperial Agent'' was one of three paintings that could be gained after the launch of "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," released on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
